newsitem.title: MOROCCO: ATHLETICS-SALAH, EL GUERROUJ TO MISS WORLD INDOORS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-SALAH, EL GUERROUJ TO MISS WORLD INDOORS.

text.p: Two of Morocco's top athletes, Hicham el Guerrouj and Hissou Salah, will miss the world indoor championships in Paris in March.
They will be concentrating on their training programme for the world outdoor championships in Athens in August, their coach Abdelkader Kadda said.
El Guerrouj was the second fastest man over 1,500 metres in 1996 but fell in the Olympic final in Atlanta.
Hissou, world 10,000 metres record holder, won a bronze medal in Atlanta. He will also skip the world cross-country championships in Italy at the end of March.
